Fun Fact: Bethlehem's Historic Stock House and Its Roofing Legacy

Bethlehem is home to the Stock House, built in 1863, the oldest remaining building on the historic Bethlehem Steel site. They renovated the building to honor its industrial past. The restoration included a steel standing seam roofing system, blending modern resilience with historical integrity. This design shows the city’s heritage and new roofing technology.
